versions.changelog:
- Adds ProWorkflow support through the OOMOL `oo` CLI connector using server-managed credentials.
- Provides read actions for projects and project items, including get, list, search, pagination, and sorting workflows.
- Supports updating selected fields on ProWorkflow projects and project items.
- Requires live schema inspection before running actions so payloads match the connector contract.
- Documents safety rules for write actions and first-time setup fallbacks for auth, connection, and billing errors.
